module: Manages the selection of layers of the Dynamic Decals tool. selectLayer copies the layer into `editor.selection["dynamicDecalLayer"][uid]` (what the inspector reads) and configures the gizmo: starting transform and translate/rotate/scale callbacks depending on the type (decal, brushStroke, path, group). deselectLayer clears the selection and disables the gizmo.
notes: The selection stores a deep copy (deepcopy) of the layer: modifying it does not modify the layer stack; you must go through api.setLayer.
Rotation and scale are only handled for decals; brushStroke, path and group only handle translation (via api.moveLayerLocalPos).
For a group, the gizmo is placed on the first draggable child. getDraggableChildLayer returns on the first child (the `return` is inside the loop): only the first child is examined.
Without addToSelection, `editor.selection` is entirely reset to {} (all editor selections are lost).

selectLayer.desc: Selects the layer `uid` (replaces the selection, unless addToSelection) and prepares the gizmo (type "drag", objectType, transform, callbacks).

uid.desc: Layer identifier; a warning is logged if it is nil.

addToSelection.desc: If true, adds to the existing selection.

deselectLayer.desc: Removes the layer `uid` from the selection, or the whole selection if uid is nil. Disables the gizmo (mode none, callbacks and data reset).

editorPreferenceValueChanged.desc: Hook called when a preference changes. Does nothing here.

setup.desc: Called by the tool: gets the tool, the API and the gizmo module.
